cd /home/admin1/projects/ai-core

import subprocess,json,pathlib,re
cid='8ee3afd1dec44f46553e0e0855de295f11c6981ba4b7d23c7764cda6a251ce8d'
info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect',cid],text=True,timeout=5))[0]

    try:

    except ValueError: pass
r={'container':cid,'running':s['Running'],'state':s['Status'],'exit':s['ExitCode'],'oom_killed':s['OOMKilled'],'started':s['StartedAt'],'entry_marker':'QWEN_CPU_OPTIMIZER_QUALIFICATION_STARTED' in lines,'result_records':records,'training_updates_confirmed':sum(x.get('optimizer_steps',0) for x in records if x['status']=='WEIGHTS_UPDATED')}
if not s['Running'] and not records:
    r['error_markers']=[x[:180] for x in lines if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z]+Error:',x)][-4:]
out=pathlib.Path('.ai-core/qualification-runs/qwen-cpu-optimizer-qualification-v1/training-result.json')
r['result_file_present']=out.is_file()
if out.is_file():
    d=json.loads(out.read_text())
    r['result_file']={k:d.get(k) for k in ('training_scope','teacher_model','optimizer_steps','supervised_tokens','adapter_before_sha256','adapter_after_sha256','artifact_sha256','production_adopted')}
body='## Qwen real CPU optimizer job status readback\n\n```json\n'+json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n```\n\nFixed local synthetic qualification only; not verified teacher distillation.'
subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment','1','--repo','seigo-gace/ai-core','--body-file','-'],input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=5)
